tree: dabb688 (pre-fix; the fix is the working tree)
method: real daemon (bin/signerd run), real example client as a separate process, one distinct wire per case (distinct lamports+blockhash) so replay cannot mask a verdict

M1_dry_flag.verdict: FAIL-OPEN: a dry request was answered with a REAL signature and a journal record

M2_duplicate_lamports.verdict: FAIL-OPEN: last value wins silently; the operator named 22 first, 999 was signed

M3_unknown_flag.verdict: FAIL-OPEN: the unknown flag was dropped without a word and the request was signed

M4_missing_value.verdict: NOT A DEFECT (guard): a required flag with no value was already refused by requireArg

M5_switch_with_value.verdict: FAIL-OPEN: a switch given a value was accepted and the request signed

first_observation: an earlier run mixed the cases onto ONE wire; the replay gate then answered {error:replay} for cases 3 and 5, masking their real verdicts. Fixed by giving each case its own wire. The instrument must not let one case consume another's identity.
